content:
The image shows opened soybean pods with seeds inside. Key visual features:
- White, cottony/fluffy mycelial growth visible on several seeds and inside the pod walls
- Some seeds are shrunken and discolored (tan/brown)
- The white fluffy growth is the hallmark sign of Sclerotinia infection

This cottony white mycelium growing on seeds within the pod is the classic presentation of **White Mold** (Sclerotinia sclerotiorum). No other class produces this fluffy white fungal growth on seeds.
